description: Search the legalaimcp.com directory of AI tools and MCP servers built for law firms. Filter by free-text query, practice-area category, and pricing model. Use this when someone asks what AI tooling exists for legal work such as contract review, legal research, client intake, billing, or compliance.

category.description: Practice-area filter — get slugs from list_legal_ai_categories

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

pricing.description: Pricing-model filter: free, freemium, paid, or contact

query.description: Free-text search over tool names, taglines, and descriptions, e.g. "contract review"

name: search_legal_ai_tools

connection.description: Reviewed setup documentation, not a compatibility or security test. Null means no reviewed setup guide is attached, not that a connector cannot exist.

install_command.description: MCP install command, if the tool ships an MCP server

links_verified.description: True if an automated check confirmed every URL on this listing resolved, as of links_verified_at. An automated link check only — NOT an endorsement, security audit, or legal review.

links_verified_at.description: ISO date of the last passing link check; null = not confirmed (often just bot-blocking)

pricing_model.description: One of: free, freemium, paid, contact

slug.description: Stable listing identifier — pass to get_legal_ai_tool

source_review.description: Dated primary-source review for the matching published claims. This is not a runtime, security or legal-output test.

title: Search legal AI tools
